summary.name: Diktatorial Suite (SoundBoost.ai)
summary.one_liner: An AI audio mastering service that analyzes a song and renders a mastered version, steered by text prompts or a reference track.
use_cases: Mastering a finished song before release
Matching the sound of a reference track
Describing a desired sound in plain words to shape a master
Comparing a master against the original mix
Adding warmth, saturation or tape character to a track
summary.what_it_does: The service analyzes an uploaded song to detect its genre, BPM, LUFS and sonic needs, then builds a signal chain from modeled analog and digital processors, including a Tape Effect, Intensity curve and True-Peak limiter modes. The render is described as taking about one minute. Users can A/B compare the master with the original mix and revise it. Subscribers get more options such as saturation, compression, analog warmth and width. Mastering Engine v3.5 offers six named AI engineer profiles (Default, Sophia, Alex, Marcus, Luna, Kai) and prompt-based mastering, where a request like "give me festival energy" sets the EQ, compression and saturation chain.
notable: Text prompt mastering (e.g. 'give me festival energy')
Six named AI mastering engine profiles in Engine v3.5
Automatic genre, BPM and LUFS analysis with a render taking about a minute
A/B comparison against the original mix
caveats: Extensive mastering options (saturation, compression, analog warmth, width) are for subscribed users only
Freemium model implies some features are paid; exact prices are not stated on the page
